name: Annowre

attributes.attribute: an Arthurian witch or sorceress, possibly the double of Morgan
captured Arthur and sent knights to fight him, then was killed by him

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Annowre is an Arthurian heroine. She is a witch, or a sorceress. Some scholars say she is the double of Morgan. She desired King Arthur and lured him into her forest. Arthur rejected her. She held him captive and sent knights to fight him one at a time. She hoped the knights would kill him. Arthur held them off. She then sent the challengers in pairs, and they overpowered him. With the help of Nimue, the knight Tristan freed the king. Arthur then killed Annowre.
objective: Record Annowre, an Arthurian witch or sorceress.
key_results: Show her lust for Arthur and her capture of him.
Show her death at Arthur's hand after Tristan freed him.
